title: TraceTheBreak
description: A civic infrastructure reporting platform: residents log road hazards and utility breaks on an interactive map, with photo verification and moderation running behind the scenes.

title: TraceTheToxin
description: An air quality and wildfire monitoring tool built on the TraceTheStuff platform, layering live NASA FIRMS fire data over air quality stations with severity-scaled markers.

title: Novi Dorćol
description: An interactive 3D visualization tool built for Novi Dorćol, a residential and commercial development by Deka Inženjering in Belgrade's Dorćol district. Lets prospective buyers explore the building exterior, browse floor-by-floor cross-sections, and check real-time apartment availability — built for client marketing while working at AR-TY.

title: Novi Dorćol — Virtual Tour
description: Immersive 360° interior walkthrough of the Novi Dorćol residential development.

title: Curio Bibliotheca
description: A browser-based ArchViz presentation tool built to showcase projects instantly, no downloads, installs, or special hardware needed, just a click. Now includes a freshly developed 360-degree tour system.

title: Kitchen Configurator
description: A realtime interactive kitchen configurator demo, letting users swap and preview materials, colors, and finishes on cabinets and surfaces directly in the browser.
